As Micron Technology (MU) Valuation Rose, Shareholder American National Insurance Company Has Raised Holding; As Pioneer Natural Resources (PXD) Share Price Rose, Shareholder Murphy Capital Management Cut Holding
May 16, 2018 - By Richard Conner
American National Insurance Company increased its stake in Micron Technology Inc. (MU) by 958.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. American National Insurance Company bought 92,050 shares as the company’s stock rose 18.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 101,650 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.18 million, up from 9,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. American National Insurance Company who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $65.43 billion market cap company. The stock increased 4.46% or $2.41 during the last trading session, reaching $56.42. About 44.33 million shares traded. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has risen 82.20% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 70.65% the S&P500.
Murphy Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Pioneer Natural Resources (PXD) by 1.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Murphy Capital Management Inc sold 2,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 110,242 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.06 million, down from 112,342 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Murphy Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Pioneer Natural Resources for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $35.19B market cap company. The stock increased 1.69% or $3.44 during the last trading session, reaching $206.49. About 635,212 shares traded.
